get_device_snapshot.description: Get complete device state in one call. Returns: device info (brand, model, screen size), foreground app, screen analysis (OCR text + UI elements), accessibility nodes, installed apps. This is your PRIMARY observation tool. Use screen_width/screen_height as the ONLY valid coordinate bounds for input actions.

screen_width.description: Screen width in pixels - use for input coordinate bounds

screen_height.description: Screen height in pixels - use for input coordinate bounds

screen_analysis.description: OCR text elements and UI detection results

ui_nodes.description: Accessibility nodes with count and nodes array

get_device_snapshot.notes: This is the primary observation command. Call it before each action to get current screen state. Response fields are at root level (not nested in 'snapshot').

go_home.description: Navigate to Android home screen using global action

press_back.description: Press the back button using global action

press_home.description: Press the home button using global action

press_recent.description: Open recent apps / app switcher using global action

press_enter.description: Press enter/submit key. Use after typing in search fields to submit the query.

run_app.description: Launch an app by package name. Use wait_for_open_ms to wait until app reaches foreground.

wait_for_open_ms.description: Time to wait for app to reach foreground (recommended: 3000)

appInForeground.description: Whether app is now in foreground

close_app.description: Close an app gracefully by sending it to background

force_stop_app.description: Force stop an app immediately (kills all its processes)

input_tap.description: Tap at specific screen coordinates. Use EXACT coordinates from get_device_snapshot observation. CRITICAL: NEVER tap outside the device screen. Valid bounds: 0 <= x < screen_width and 0 <= y < screen_height (from the latest snapshot).

x.description: X coordinate in pixels. MUST satisfy 0 <= x < screen_width.

y.description: Y coordinate in pixels. MUST satisfy 0 <= y < screen_height.

duration_ms.description: Tap duration in ms. Use 500+ for long-press.

draw_tap.description: draw a tap overlay on screen for visual debugging

input_swipe.description: Swipe from point A to point B. CRITICAL: NEVER swipe outside the device screen. All coordinates MUST satisfy 0 <= x < screen_width and 0 <= y < screen_height (from the latest snapshot). For SCROLL DOWN (see content below): start high (y1), end low (y2). For SCROLL UP: start low, end high.

x1.description: Start X coordinate in pixels. MUST be within [0, screen_width).

y1.description: Start Y coordinate in pixels. MUST be within [0, screen_height).

x2.description: End X coordinate in pixels. MUST be within [0, screen_width).

y2.description: End Y coordinate in pixels. MUST be within [0, screen_height).

input_scroll.description: Scroll at a specific location using scroll events (like mouse wheel). CRITICAL: NEVER scroll outside the device screen. Coordinates MUST be within bounds from the latest get_device_snapshot (0 <= x < screen_width, 0 <= y < screen_height).

x.description: Scroll center X coordinate in pixels. MUST be within [0, screen_width).

y.description: Scroll center Y coordinate in pixels. MUST be within [0, screen_height).

ticks.description: Scroll amount. Positive=scroll up, Negative=scroll down. 120 = 1 page.

type_text.description: Type text into the CURRENTLY FOCUSED input field. IMPORTANT: You MUST tap on an input field first to focus it before using this command!

clear_text.description: Clear text from the currently focused input field

wait.description: Wait for UI to update. Handled locally (not sent to device). Use after actions that change the screen.

vibrate_device.description: Vibrate the device for feedback or notification

toast.description: Show a toast message on the device screen

get_screenshot.description: Get a screenshot as base64 JPEG. Usually not needed - use get_device_snapshot instead for structured data.

quality.description: JPEG quality 1-100 (higher = better quality, larger size)

set_screen_brightness.description: Set the device screen brightness level

get_screen_brightness.description: Get the current screen brightness level

set_dark_mode.description: Enable or disable system dark mode

enabled.description: true = dark mode on, false = light mode

dark_mode.description: true if dark mode is enabled

volume_mute.description: Mute or unmute device media volume

mute.description: true to mute, false to unmute

disable_status_bar.description: Lock/disable status bar to prevent accidental pull-down during automation

enable_status_bar.description: Re-enable status bar after disabling it

clear_app_cache.description: Clear cached data for a specific app

package.description: Package name of app to clear cache

draw_rect.description: Draw a rectangle overlay on screen for visual debugging

draw_circle.description: Draw a circle overlay on screen for visual debugging

clear_overlays.description: Clear all debug overlays from screen
